d: About Group: Delight Investment Group (DIG) is an Abu Dhabi-based multi-vertical holding group with a diverse portfolio of investments in sectors including transport and logistics, facilities management, information technology, and trading of specialized oil and gas equipment supplies. DIG has a significant regional and international presence with offices across the GCC, U.K., EU, and India, and a workforce of over 2,000 employees.

Company Description: DGL is an integrated logistics and freight forwarding company headquartered in Abu Dhabi, with operational offices in Dubai (Jebel Ali, DAFZA), KEZAD, India, and China. With over a decade of operational experience, we have built a strong reputation for reliability, efficiency, and excellence across every phase of the logistics value chain.

Role Description: The Freight Forwarding Operations Executive will manage end-to-end air and sea freight operations, including import/export documentation, Saudi Customs clearance, shipment coordination, and timely delivery. The role requires strong knowledge of Saudi Customs procedures and close coordination with airlines, shipping lines, ports, customs brokers, transporters, and logistics partners to ensure smooth, compliant, and efficient operations.
q: Minimum 4–7 years of relevant experience in freight forwarding/logistics operations in Saudi Arabia.
Strong practical knowledge of Saudi Customs and import/export procedures.
Good knowledge of Saudi geographical locations, airports, seaports, and logistics hubs.
Experience dealing with airlines, shipping lines, customs brokers, transporters, and local vendors.
Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Languages: English and Hindi required; Arabic is highly preferred.
Candidates currently based in Riyadh/Saudi Arabia with relevant local experience will be preferred.
r: Handle end-to-end operations for airfreight and seafreight import and export shipments.
Have comprehensive knowledge of Saudi Customs procedures, customs clearance requirements, approvals, permits, and documentation.
Coordinate with customs, government authorities, airlines, shipping lines, ports, transporters, and other service providers.
Manage shipments through major airports and seaports across Saudi Arabia.
Coordinate with local transporters, customs brokers, warehouses, and other logistics vendors.
Handle shipping line and airline documentation, bookings, shipment tracking, and delivery coordination.
Ensure timely customs clearance and delivery of shipments to clients.
Resolve operational issues, shipment delays, customs queries, and documentation discrepancies.
Maintain proper shipment records and ensure compliance with company procedures and Saudi regulations.
Coordinate closely with the sales and customer service teams to provide timely shipment updates to clients.
Develop and maintain good working relationships with local vendors and logistics service providers.

d: Eden Rose is currently engaged with a financial institution based in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) who are seeking an Operations Manager to join their team.

Reporting to the Executive Director, you will oversee the firm's day-to-day operational activities, ensuring effective processes, robust internal controls and adherence to applicable DFSA regulatory requirements.
r: Oversee the day-to-day operational activities of the firm, ensuring efficient and effective investment management operations.
Manage and coordinate fund and investment operations, including trade processing, settlements, reconciliations and transaction monitoring from an operational perspective.
Oversee relationships with external service providers, including fund administrators, custodians, brokers and other relevant counterparties.
Oversee fund administration activities, including NAV calculations, valuations, subscriptions, redemptions and associated reconciliations, where applicable.
Ensure operational policies, procedures, systems and controls are maintained in accordance with internal requirements and applicable DFSA regulations.
Identify, assess and mitigate operational risks, ensuring appropriate controls and escalation procedures are in place.
Work closely with Finance, Compliance, Investment Management and senior management to ensure effective coordination across business functions.
Oversee operational reporting, maintain accurate records and support internal and external audits and regulatory reviews.
Identify opportunities to streamline processes, enhance operational efficiency and implement improvements to systems and procedures.
Support the implementation of new business initiatives, investment products and operational projects.
Provide operational updates and management information to senior management, highlighting key risks, challenges and areas for improvement.

The Operations Manager will hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics or a related discipline. You will have a minimum 7–10 years' relevant experience within investment management, asset management, fund management or financial services operations and previous experience in an Operations Manager or senior investment operations role within a regulated financial institution. Experience working within a DIFC/DFSA-regulated environment is highly desirable; ADGM/FSRA or comparable regulatory experience will also be considered.

You will have a strong understanding of investment and fund operations, including trade lifecycle management, settlements, reconciliations and oversight of external service providers. You will have experience coordinating with fund administrators, custodians, brokers, auditors and other external stakeholders.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for an experienced professional to take ownership of the operations function. Please apply now or for further information contact Kayte Short at Eden Rose at kayte.short@edenrose.ae

Good level of IT with Microsoft office skills
